name: Scale features for linear and distance-based models
recommendation: Use standard scaling when the selected model family benefits from comparable feature scales.
reason_template: Numeric features are present, and scaling helps linear and distance-based models perform consistently.
limitations: Less important for many tree-based models

name: Keep scaling optional for tree-based pipelines

conditions.description: The recommended model family is tree-based.

recommendation: Treat scaling as optional for tree-based models.
reason_template: Tree-based models are usually less sensitive to feature scaling, so scaling can remain optional.
limitations: Not ideal if a later model choice changes to a scale-sensitive model
